relevance.rationale: The folio carries a §3b conditional class QOU.BraidKnot.AJTrefoil.StrongAJTrefoil, documented as a 'literature theorem' class, whose only in-file citation is garoufalidis2004 (the AJ conjecture statement) — the strong (Sikora A-ideal) form for torus knots is asserted but not sourced. The registered neighbours cover the figure-eight (nguyen-tran-2021) and two-bridge knots (le2006); the torus-knot / cable side is uncited. This paper states the torus-knot case explicitly (§0.3, crediting Sikora for the trefoil and Tran for all torus knots) and proves the cabled extension. The folio also builds dressed particles by a cabling embedding, so the cabled colored-Jones formula is potentially usable machinery. Corpus-grep: no ref() entry, no 'cables' match in references.ts.

keyResults.statement: The strong AJ conjecture holds for each (r,s)-cabled knot over each (p,q)-torus knot provided r is not a number between 0 and pqs.
keyResults.useForFolio: Citable literature backing for the strong-AJ class on the trefoil (a torus knot) and, with the stated hypothesis on r, for its cabled descendants — the regime the folio's dressed-particle construction lives in.

keyResults.statement: The colored Jones of the (r,s)-cable K_(r,s) is an explicit finite signed sum of colored Jones values of K at shifted colors, J_{K_(r,s)}(n) = t^{-rs(n^2-1)} sum_j ... .
keyResults.useForFolio: A concrete formula for the colored-Jones tower of a cabled knot, usable if the folio ever needs the tower of a dressed (cabled) particle rather than of its core knot.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan; the strong-AJ torus-knot/cable claim in the Lean class has no source.

StrongAJTrefoil is declared a literature-theorem class; its docstring should carry the strong-AJ source (this paper's §0.3 for torus knots, Thm 1 for cables), not only garoufalidis2004's statement of the ordinary AJ conjecture.
